/** com.khnp.pels.api.TstStrokeSelectList */ SELECT TST_UNQ_KY_VAL , PAGE_NO , STROKE_SEQ , POINT_PATH , STROKE_COLOR , STROKE_WIDTH , CREPR_ID , TO_CHAR(CRE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS CRE_DT , DLTPR_ID , TO_CHAR(DLT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3') AS DLT_DT FROM GE_MP_CHECK_STRK_S WHERE TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{value} ORDER BY PAGE_NO , STROKE_SEQ
